standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-base-change-rig-etale-homomorphism at proof lines 2328-2329 and lemma-rig-etale at lines 2336-2338
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that B_m = B/(a_t^m) stays rig-etale over the reduced pair and that C_m may be chosen etale over the complement of V(I-bar_m).

standard_prerequisites.name: Etale lifting machinery
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the compatibilization step C_m/(a_t^{m-1}) -> C_{m-1} and the lift C''_m of C_{m-1} to an algebra over A-bar_m.

standard_prerequisites.name: NL comparison and rig-etale transfer
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that B' = lim C_m is topologically finite type, that the NL cohomologies agree, and the uniform annihilation transferring rig-etale-ness from B to B'.

core_obligations: 归纳设置：t=0 无事、t=1 经 principal 引理；B_m = B/(a_t^m) 经基变换引理保持 rig-etale（2317-2329 行）。
归纳假设给 C_m→B_m 完合同构，lemma-rig-etale 调整为在补集上 etale（2332-2338 行）。

相容化：C_m/(a_t^{m-1}) 在补集上 etale，经 fully-faithful-etale-over-complement 找 C'_{m-1}；etale 永存+无穷小邻域判据+étale 拓扑不变性升级为 C_m→C'_m；2368 行 (details omitted) 为 etale（平坦）映射的完备基变换标准事实单步实例化（注记）；经 lift-approximation 取提昇 C''_m（2341-2378 行）。
收尾：(C_m) 属 (a_t) 主理想情形的范畴 (equation-C)，B'=lim C_m 拓扑有限型；NL_{C_m/A_m} 上同调 I-完备且与 NL_{B_m/A_m} 同调同构；经 equivalent-with-artin 得 B' rig-etale over (A,(a_t))；principal 引理收尾（2381-2403 行）。
proof_roadmap: 归纳设置与基变换（2317-2329 行）。
归纳假设与 etale 调整（2332-2338 行）。
极限、NL 比较、principal 收尾（2381-2403 行）。
